season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Atonement
movement.line: Name it. Bring it. Be cleansed.

x: And Joseph said to them, Fear not, for I am God's.
Ye took counsel against me for evil, but God took counsel for me for good, that [the matter] might be as [it is] to-day, and much people might be fed.
And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
Then, having come, Peter said to Him, “Lord, how often will my brother sin against me, and I will forgive him? Up to seven times?”
Jesus says to him, “I do not say to you, up to seven times, but up to seventy-seven times!

days.t: Be merciful, as your Father is merciful
x: Be merciful, as also your⁺ Father is merciful.
And do not judge, and you⁺ shall not be judged; and do not condemn, and you⁺ shall not be condemned; release, and you⁺ will be released.

days.t: Forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you
x: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as also God in Christ forgave you⁺.

days.t: Bear with one another and forgive
x: bearing with one another and forgiving each other, if anyone may have a complaint toward another. Just as also the Lord forgave you⁺, so also you⁺.
